root_idea.summary: The root centers on the amount, extent, limit, or proper measure of a thing, including its inherent nature and end.
root_idea.development: From determining a thing's measure and limits, the root develops meanings of estimating, proportioning, appointing or decreeing an outcome, possessing the ability to accomplish it, and restricting it to a limited amount.

senses.definition: To measure, estimate, appraise, or determine the amount, extent, or proper measure of something.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes assessing something's magnitude or worth and determining it by comparison or calculation.

senses.definition: To have power or ability to do, attain, or prevail in something.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction قَدَرَ عَلَى denotes ability or power over an action or object.

senses.definition: To restrict, straiten, or make scanty.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used of restricting provision or making circumstances narrow; the passive construction قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ has the same restricted sense.

senses.definition: To determine, decree, appoint, or apportion an outcome or provision.
senses.usage_conditions: The sense presents an outcome or allotment as fixed according to a determined measure; it also underlies the Quranic discussion of apportioning provision.

senses.definition: To deliberate over, arrange, and plan a matter.
senses.usage_conditions: Can describe considered planning based on reason, or blameworthy plotting driven by desire; the context determines the evaluation.

senses.definition: To decree, appoint, ordain, destine, or predetermine something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of fixing an event, condition, time, or outcome by determination.

senses.definition: To make, establish, proportion, or set something according to a determined arrangement.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes assigning a thing its ordered features, stations, provisions, or course; it is not limited to numerical measurement.

senses.definition: To know or recognize something through consideration.
senses.usage_conditions: This interpretation is reported for particular Quranic constructions and should not be generalized to every Form II occurrence.

senses.definition: A specified measure, amount, proportion, or duration.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to the measure assigned to a thing or to the extent of a period of time.

senses.definition: Decreed, determined, destined, or appointed.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes what comes about as the result of a prior determination or decree.

senses.definition: Fully powerful or capable; one who possesses extensive power to accomplish what is intended.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences this is a divine predicate; in broader Arabic the form can also be applied to a human who has acquired or exercises power.

senses.definition: Having power or ability to do, effect, or accomplish something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the form chiefly as a divine predicate; ability is understood relative to the action or object in the construction.

senses.definition: A measure, amount, extent, or amount appropriate to a person or thing.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes an allotted means, capacity, or quantity and the measure suited to a particular case.

senses.definition: An appointed time, period, or place.
senses.usage_conditions: The surrounding construction determines whether the measured limit is temporal, spatial, or an appointed occasion.

senses.definition: A decree, appointment, ordinance, or destined outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: Refers to a particular determination or destiny, including what is appointed for a specified case.

senses.definition: All-powerful or fully capable, acting according to what wisdom requires.
senses.usage_conditions: This intensive divine predicate denotes power without incapacity and, in the Quranic usage, is applied to God.

senses.definition: Estimation, appraisal, worth, rank, or due honor.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ it denotes the estimation, recognition, or honor due to someone.

senses.definition: A measure or determined amount.
senses.usage_conditions: Refers to an amount fixed or appropriate to a thing or circumstance.

senses.definition: A decree or appointed determination.
senses.usage_conditions: In لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ, the noun denotes a night appointed for specific matters; the passage is also associated in the evidence with divine apportionment.

senses.definition: A cooking-pot or vessel used for cooking.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural قُدُور occurs in the Quranic form group; the citation form is the singular قِدْر.

senses.definition: Measuring, proportioning, or setting something to a specified measure.
senses.usage_conditions: Can describe the measured course, form, amount, or duration assigned to something.

senses.definition: Determination, ordaining, or decree.
senses.usage_conditions: Refers to the act or result of fixing an outcome, arrangement, or destiny.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compare one thing or case with another, consider an affair and its outcome, and assess its parts in relation to one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A related extension of measuring and estimating; it may describe deliberate consideration rather than numerical calculation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare or make something ready.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use distinct from merely estimating or decreeing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign or appoint a particular time for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a time fixed for an event or action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suppose, posit, or take something to be the case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a classical cognitive use and is distinct from formally decreeing an outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In grammatical analysis, to supply or understand an implied expression or meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical construction, opposed to what is stated literally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To label or call someone a Qadarī.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A post-classical sectarian usage reported in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To empower, enable, or render someone able to do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative construction gives a person capacity rather than merely describing the person's existing ability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To measure one's abilities against another and vie or contend with that person in power or strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal or comparative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compute or reckon in one's mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited use concerns reckoning turns or intervals; it is not a separate meaning of the basic verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become prepared or ready for someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing becoming fitted or ready for its intended recipient or use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fit, agree with, or conform to another's measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of a garment that fits a person's measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something of moderate or middling size.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The size may concern length, height, width, or breadth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek from God that He decree good or grant the power to accomplish something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form occurs in supplicative constructions requesting favorable determination or ability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Power or ability.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of capacity or ability, without the absolute theological force reserved for the divine predicate قَدِير.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Competence, sufficiency, or material means; richness sufficient for a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person possessing enough ability or resources for an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fixed interval or distance between two palm-trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural measurement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Qadarī sect, described as denying that decree proceeds from God and attributing it to themselves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sectarian derivative, not a general meaning of قَدَر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cook, or a person who slaughters animals and cooks their meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The occupational name is associated with cooking in a قِدْر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Meat or food cooked in a cooking-pot; cooked broth or pottage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This noun is distinct from قَدِير meaning powerful and from the active participle قَادِر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy or gentle, as a night's journey involving no fatigue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use in the expression لَيْلَةٌ قَادِرَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure or an instrument or pattern by which something is measured, proportioned, or cut.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader instrumental sense is not asserted for the Quranic occurrences merely because they denote measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A term of life or the point at which a person's allotted lifespan ends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic use of the measured limit of life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing, saddle, or bodily form of moderate or middling size.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The specialization may describe length, height, width, breadth, or a saddle between small and large.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Short-necked, or having a gait in which the hind hooves land where the fore hooves landed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective applied to people or animals and derived from the idea of being set to a particular measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An artificer gentle or skillful in his work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use distinct from the Quranic predicate of full power.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cook meat or other food in a cooking-pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical verbal use with the cooking-pot as the vessel in which the food is prepared.

The idiomatic term of life is preserved.
The specialized gentle-artificer use is preserved.

cautions: The interpretation of قَدْر in لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ is reported with different English renderings; the supplied lexical discussion specifically supports decree, appointment, and allocation for this construction, not an independently established standalone sense of power.

For فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ, the supplied evidence records an interpretive alternative between straitening and decreeing; the listed Quranic sense follows the explicitly explained straitening interpretation while retaining the decree branch elsewhere.
